headline: The finite-dimensional convexity core of the tensor maximum principle is kernel-checked unconditionally: the PSD cone is closed/convex and invariant under the explicit Euler step of any positivity-preserving reaction; the reaction term controls the quadratic form exactly in null directions; a null-direction violation of Hamilton's boundary condition destroys the Euler step; the boundary condition is proved strictly weaker than global positivity preservation; in dimension 1 the cone invariance is a theorem reduced to the scalar reaction ODE, whose correct two-sided hypothesis is justified by a formal counterexample to the one-sided version; quadratic-form monotonicity along a flow is unconditional. The general continuous tensor maximum principle is isolated as the clearly named statement-only Prop ConeInvariantUnderReaction and used only as an explicit hypothesis. No sorry, axiom, unsafe, native_decide or proof_wanted; all 33 audited declarations have cone [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

1_definitions.psd_cone: psdCone n = {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R | A.PosSemidef}; shown closed (Matrix.posSemidef_is_closed) and convex
1_definitions.loewner_order: Mathlib's Matrix partial order A <= B <-> (B - A).PosSemidef restated as le_iff_sub_posSemidef / nonneg_iff_posSemidef
1_definitions.quadratic_form: quadForm A x = x dot (A mulVec x); nonneg for PSD A; zero iff x is in the kernel; PSD <=> all quadratic forms nonnegative (test-function description)
1_definitions.reaction_conditions: PositivityPreserving Q (global) and BoundaryPositivityPreserving Q (Hamilton null-eigenvector condition); PositivityPreserving.boundary

2_discrete_tensor_maximum_principle.monotonicity: eulerStep_mono (A <= A + eps * Q A in the Loewner order)
2_discrete_tensor_maximum_principle.examples: PositivityPreserving.zero/.id/.const_smul/.sq/.add/.comp, positivityPreserving_const_smul_add_sq, exp_smul_posSemidef (consistency with the explicit solution exp(ct) * S0)
2_discrete_tensor_maximum_principle.sharpness: not_positivityPreserving_neg; boundary_condition_strictly_weaker (boundary condition does not imply global positivity preservation, so the Euler scheme is strictly weaker than the continuous theorem)

3_scalar_case.main: scalar_forward_invariance (q nonnegative on a two-sided neighbourhood (-delta, inf), delta > 0)
3_scalar_case.proof: first-exit set A = {t | forall s <= t, -delta < y s}, t0 = sSup A; monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg on [0,t0]; Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff extends A past t0 if t0 < T
3_scalar_case.nonvacuity: exp_shift_forward_invariance (y t = 2 exp t - 2, q v = v + 2, delta = 2)
3_scalar_case.counterexample: scalar_invariance_oneSided_false: q nonnegative only on [0,inf) is NOT enough; witness y(t) = -t^2, q(v) = -2 sqrt(-v) for v < 0 and 0 for v >= 0, y' = q o y on [0,1], y 0 = 0, y 1 = -1

4_continuum_interface.statement_only_prop: ConeInvariantUnderReaction Q (forward viability of the PSD cone for S' = Q(S)); a definition, used only as an explicit hypothesis
unconditional_consequences: quadForm_monotone_of_reaction_posSemidef (reaction PSD along the flow => every quadratic form is nondecreasing)
coneInvariantUnderReaction_oneByOne (dimension 1: the Prop holds whenever the scalar reaction is nonnegative on (-delta, inf))

scope_limits: The general continuous tensor maximum principle (arbitrary dimension, sharp null-eigenvector condition) is NOT proved; it is the statement-only Prop ConeInvariantUnderReaction used as an explicit hypothesis in tensor_maximum_principle_ode.

No PDE is formalized: the flow is the reaction ODE S' = Q(S). The spatial Laplacian, the manifold setting and the reduction 'PDE maximum principle at the first touching time => cone invariance' are out of scope (the scalar parabolic maximum principle on a bounded domain is the sibling task D10-maximum-principle-rn).

Necessity of the null-eigenvector condition for the continuous flow is not proved; only the Euler-step obstruction (not_posSemidef_eulerStep_of_nullVector) and the strict weakness of the boundary condition (boundary_condition_strictly_weaker) are.
Strong maximum principle, positive definiteness / interior of the cone, and the general diagonal (decoupled) case are not treated.
The dimension-1 unconditional theorem coneInvariantUnderReaction_oneByOne reduces to the scalar ODE; dimensions >= 2 unconditional statements are limited to the discrete (explicit Euler) invariance.
